{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-cvbb","title":"with_store freezes clock at 0 so persisted SAT2 leases never expire","description":"File: rust/lichen-rpl/src/address_assignment.rs
Perspective: correctness (dual-impl)

ShortAddressCoordinator::with_store() calls build(store, None, SHORT_POOL_SIZE, None, unix_zero). unix_zero always returns 0 and lease_seconds is None.

On load, decode_table_state() restores SAT2 expiries, then prune_expired() runs with now=0. Deadlines such as 160 are not <= 0, so expired rows stay in by_short/by_eui. Because lease_seconds is None, later process() never refreshes or honors those deadlines either.

Python ShortAddressCoordinator(store=store) defaults clock to time.time() and prunes persisted expiries on construct even when lease_seconds is None. Rust with_store is the obvious restart constructor and silently immortalizes leased assignments. Lease restart tests avoid this by using with_lease() plus an injected clock, so the divergence is untested.

Fix: with_store must take (or default to) a real clock and prune with current time; loading SAT2 with expiries must not depend on with_lease being used. ShortAddressCoordinator::with_store() calls build(store, None, SHORT_POOL_SIZE, None, unix_zero). unix_zero always returns 0 and lease_seconds is None.

Lease restart tests avoid this by using with_lease() plus an injected clock, so the divergence is untested.

Fix: with_store must take (or default to) a real clock and prune with current time; loading SAT2 with expiries must not depend on with_lease being used. new_value: with_store now prunes SAT2 expiries against unix_now (Python time.time default). unix_now fails closed on pre-epoch clocks instead of returning 0. Regression: canonical expiry 160 is kept by a frozen clock at 0 and dropped by with_store; cargo test -p lichen-rpl --features std --lib address_assignment:: (13 passed) and --test address_assignment_vectors (13 passed).
